# Academic Research Skills for DeepSeek Harness

A complete DeepSeek Harness (DSH) port of
`academic-research-skills`:
contract-audited academic rese

arch, paper writing, simulated peer review,
systematic-review screening, and an end-to-end research

→ write → review →
revise → finalize pipeline.

The upstream repository content is shipped in `payload/`: 1,201 included
files copied byte-for-byte

from the pinned commit. Four full-page third-party
web-page mirrors (IEEE, Springer Nature, ICMJE, a

nd one CC BY article) are
deliberately **not** distributed because their rights holders' terms are n

ot
covered by the upstream CC-BY-NC grant; the manifest that records their URLs,
Wayback IDs, and SH

A-256 is kept.
Everything outside `payload/` is the DSH adapter: skill/command registration,
DeepSee

k Harness tool and path adaptation, deterministic Python tooling, and the
write-scope guard.
## License and commercial use

This is an **unofficial** DeepSeek Harness port. It is not affiliated with,
sponsored by, or endorse
d by Cheng-I Wu or the upstream project.

The package is distributed under **CC BY-NC 4.0** (SPDX `CC-BY-NC-4.0`), the
same license as the ups

tream content. **Non-commercial use only.** This is
source-public, non-commercial software; it is no

t OSI open source. Project
policy (2026-10-28): the maintainer does not offer or pursue a commercial

license. Commercial use requires permission from the upstream author
(Cheng-I Wu); this project doe

s not grant it. Do not contact the adapter author
for a commercial license.
Attribution, as requested upstream:

> Based on Academic Research Skills by Cheng-I Wu
> https://github.com/Imbad0202/academic-research-s

kills
> Licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.

The runtime announcement and every adapted prelude repeat this attribution, so
the credit travels wi

th the text the model reads. See `NOTICE.md`,
`LICENSE`, and `ASSET-LICENSES.md`.

Third-party content and API terms are audited separately in
`docs/third-party-audit.md`. Two constra

ints
survive the upstream licence: the default citation gate calls Semantic Scholar,
whose API licen

ce is non-commercial; and the payload's condensed COREQ/STROBE
checklists require permission for com
mercial redistribution.
An optional technical helper remains for downstream users who independently obtain the necessary per

missions; it is not an offered commercial path and does not grant a licence:
`tools/build-commercial

.mjs` produces a separate
copy with Semantic Scholar skipped, COREQ/STROBE replaced by pointers, and

IEEE
quotations paraphrased; see `docs/commercial-build.md`.
It does not grant a licence.
## Runtime and search defaults

- **Model:** DeepSeek Flash through DeepSeek Harness. No Claude model, Claude
CLI, or Claude API is

required at runtime; upstream `sonnet`/`opus` labels are
treated as quality tiers and rewritten to `

deepseek-flash`.
- **Context:** DeepSeek Flash's 1,048,576-token context is used directly: the
adapt

er tells the model to load complete references, keep one evidence ledger,
[该节后续省略]
## What the port exposes
| Surface | Count | Names |
| Skills | 5 | `deep-research`, `academic-paper`, `academic-paper-reviewer`, `academic-pipeline`, `s

r-screener` |
| Agent-role skills | 4 | `ars-agent-synthesis`, `ars-agent-research-architect`, `ars-

agent-report-compiler`, `ars-agent-screening-reviewer` |
| Slash commands | 16 | `/ars-full`, `/ars-
plan`, `/ars-outline`, `/ars-revision`, `/ars-revision-coach`, `/ars-rebuttal-audit`, `/ars-abstract
`, `/ars-lit-review`, `/ars-3w`, `/ars-reviewer`, `/ars-format-convert`, `/ars-citation-check`, `/ar

s-disclosure`, `/ars-mark-read`, `/ars-unmark-read`, `/ars-cache-invalidate` |
| Tools | 3 | `ars_st

atus`, `ars_script`, `ars_env_setup` |
| Hook layers | 2 | Session-start announce section; write-sco
pe guard (infrastructure protection; the upstream phase fence is reported `unavailable` because DSH

exposes no agent type) |
| Modes | 35 | Defined by the upstream skills; see `payload/MODE_REGISTRY.m

d` |
| Agent role files | 47 | 43 unique roles: 4 plugin-exposed agent-role skills + 39 inline role
prompts; the 4 root files are byte-identical mirrors |

The port is faithful: the upstream instructions, mode protocols, templates,
references, quality gate

s, Material Passport, citation verification scripts, and
SR screening scripts are all included and r

al Passport, citation verification scripts, and
SR screening scripts are all included and reachable.
## DeepSeek Harness compatibility layer
The adapter rewrites, at registration time only (payload files stay untouched):

- `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` → the payload root;
- `academic-research-skills:<skill>` → the plain DSH s

`Bash`→`bash`, `Grep`→`grep`, `Glob`→`glob`,
`WebSearch`→`web_search`, `WebFetch`→`web_fetch`, `Tod
`/`opus`/`haiku`) → `deepseek-flash`; `Claude Code` → `DeepSeek Harness`; `.claude/...` runtime path

s → the plugin layout;
- `$ARGUMENTS` in command bodies → the raw user input.

See `docs/compat-report.md` for the counted token
inventory and the residual-pattern audit.
## Known limitations

- **Command UI execution**: `/ars-*` handlers are unit-tested with a fake
invocation, and their regi

stration is verified at runtime through
`ars_status`; the plugin does not drive the Web composer its

elf.
- **Guard phase fence**: unavailable by design. DSH does not expose an
`agent_type` on tool exe

cutions; `ars_status` reports the mode and reason
instead of pretending the fence is active.
- **Upd

ate checker**: upstream's `/plugin update` reminder is not ported; the
pinned payload is upgraded wi

th `tools/check-upstream.mjs` and a rebuild (see
`UPGRADING.md`), not in place.
- **Claude Code hook

s file**: `payload/hooks/hooks.json` is kept for provenance
but not executed; its two behaviors are

replaced by the announce section and
the tool guard.
- **Non-commercial license**: CC-BY-NC-4.0 appl

ies to the whole package; see
License and commercial use.
